asr.full_text: . He was Milton Friedman, the Nobel Prize winner in economy and visioner. In 1999, he was talking about a world that is changing and the appearance of a planetary currency that will revolutionize the financial transactions. He died before seeing the fulfilled prophecy. Today, 15 years after his speech, the change he announced becomes feel and it's spectacular. This is my camera taken from two of the classic, with a little bit of a big base. A few processors of each, and processors each with 5 video devices. At the top edge of his house in Cluj Vlad Mandiuc has a little El Dorado, hiding in a strange device, full of lights, cables and complicated pieces. It's a kind of computer that helps him do virtually what the Americans did for tv, just to see how the US people were doing in a golden platter. He calls it a mine, because this is what the million earths, who found out in the last 4 years how you can make a fabulous asset with zero effort. A virtual mine that can become real anytime is called Bitcoin. A coin that doesn't exist, you can't keep it in your hand or organize in paper. But that enriches you every minute, just letting this strange device work by itself. It's a coin that evolves so quickly that people doubled their supply within one month. In the summer I met my client who bought 20 bitcoins for $100 each, A friend of mine bought a few coins for her and she sold them in a 4-month sale. She bought a fiat, took a vacation, got some presents from her mother in law. She moved to Spain, to apply a lawyer. She doesn't want to work in winter, I want to think about summer. Vlad Mandiuc hasn't reached this level of performance yet, simply because he was very sceptic for some time... And he is sorry I have lost a very, very strong start If I entered the Bitcoin sphere, for a year and a half to be precise, from the very first time I heard we would have earned so much at the present time Very, very much and one and a half year after I heard this I was a winner. Really, really a winner. But even so, it's not too bad, in December 2013 invests 1700€ in the strange application made by the guy that says it's going after bitcoin. A month later it did, and now there is a good profit. This is my account and I should of bitcoin sum somewhere here 0,1462 bitcoin These are the last two days of the morning It went incredibly well and profitable It can seem like a low amount of money, it isn't At the moment of the interview, a bitcoin was worth $ 812 which means that Vlad Mandiuc made $ 116 in 2 days And if the currency will run at the same pace, at the end of the month, the miner will have 3-4,000 USD, without doing anything. it's so simple, a single site, this is the amount of my profit every day, and the calculation power, the more I mine now. the username is your bitcoin address, where they will put money that was mined by you inside everyone else everyday Although it seems too cool to be true,bitcoin has actually richened millions of earths More,states as germany for example, world-wide companies as ebay or google,casinos around las veinos already accept Bitcoin. This coin appeared as such is a mystery. The birth of Bitcoin is connected to the name Satoshi Nakamoto, but as no one has ever seen or heard him speak before, there is suspicion that it is just a pseudonym that can hide anything. It can be a person, it can be a company, it can be any entity that relationships, it can also be a group of people. But on the big picture, to know about him has collaborated at the start of bitcoin. To set up the network. To inform first people that have mined. He has produced his first bitcoin and at the current time Satoshi Nakamoto holds a quite large amount of Bitcoins, and has no idea of them. The currency emerged in 2009, and it seems that the mysterious Nakamoto kept within a virtual mine, that is to say, in the game program, a count of 21 million Bitcoins. Then he taught people how to scan them. More precisely, how to solve an equation. If you find the result, the system releases twenty-five bitcoins. The one who discovers the solution receives half of the quantity, and the rest is distributed, according to an algorithm, to the other earthlings who mine at the same time. Then, the system emits a new equation. In the first years it was so easy to find the solution that someone can execute it with the help of a calculator. Today's number was 12 million bitcoin, equivalent to 10 billion of dollars. Now there are only nine million bitcoin, and the number of search engines has increased a lot, so the equations and a surge in search numbers. So equations became increasingly complex. For them to get by, virtual miners began to buy more powerful computers and to collaborate in large groups, where their invested sums, a lot of cash and profit were shared equally. The ITmen think that Nakamoto's mine will be gonna dry for a century, and that the Last Cent's bitcoin calculators will work for years, and until then the value of a bitcoin could be tens or hundreds of times bigger, because the coin grew a lot in the last two years and who invested time, is a very rich person, today. The first bitcoin transaction represented the flow rate for production of bitcoin. of the current for bitcoin making. The next transaction was a pizza that sold with 10 000 BTC. Now, you can go to space with 200 BTC and you can buy an island out of 100 000 BTC. The Bitcoin price has increased about 200 times every year. The price evolution in 2012 is now 1,000 times higher than one million years ago. In 2015, the price of Bitcoin grew maybe 200 times. This is the evolution of price, per hour, per day and so on, per minute In 2012, bitcoin price was $3. From 2012 until 2013, at the beginning, the price has reached $12! So it has gone up 4 times in a year... After that, here in October, massive investments in Bitcoin, at which time, the price reached its historic maximum of $1200.

textual.observation: A reported €1,700 investment in an application associated with Bitcoin is linked to a claimed profit one month later.

evidence.quote: in December 2013 invests 1700€ in the strange application made by the guy that says it's going after bitcoin. A month later it did, and now there is a good profit.

textual.context: Presented as part of an account of an individual's Bitcoin-related experience; whether this is a recommendation or reported example is unclear.
textual.potential_relevance: The stated payment or investment is directly linked to a claimed near-term profit, creating a reward-and-money-flow relationship for later context assessment.
textual.limitations: The records do not establish who received the €1,700, whether the profit was realized or verified, or whether viewers were asked to make the same investment.

textual.observation: Bitcoin mining is associated with a projected return of 3,000 to 4,000 USD by the end of the month without doing anything.

evidence.quote: at the end of the month, the miner will have 3-4,000 USD, without doing anything.

textual.limitations: The source does not establish whether the amount was guaranteed, actually received, or what equipment, investment, fees, or other conditions applied.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes OneCoin as a once-in-a-lifetime business opportunity and presents cryptocurrency mining through an automated device as a route to continual enrichment. It describes a 1,700-euro investment, later profit, projected monthly returns of 3,000 to 4,000 USD without doing anything, and receiving mined funds through a Bitcoin address. The segment may be partly reportorial and does not show a completed transaction or verified payout.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The content links a Bitcoin-related application and mining activity to reported and projected returns: the narration reports investing in the application followed by a claimed profit, describes a miner's projected return, and describes mined money being received at a Bitcoin address. The evidence supports a mining-return relationship, but does not establish a purchase of mining equipment, package, membership, or hashpower, or verify the stated returns.
